dialogues.speaker: Alphonso
dialogues.text: The mission... I don't want to deal with it... What should I do? If the kids... Rana...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Let's leave quietly.)

dialogues.speaker: Alphonso
dialogues.text: There's no other choice... It must be done...

dialogues.speaker: Alphonso
dialogues.text: Vimara Village is such a great place... If you live here for some time, you'll definitely fall in love with it too.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why are you staying in Vimara Village?

dialogues.speaker: Alphonso
dialogues.text: Where should I begin? Hmm... I came to Sumeru with my teacher to participate in the Akademiya's symposium. We passed by this place, and somehow I wanted to stay...

dialogues.speaker: Alphonso
dialogues.text: Vimara Village is much more comfortable than Fontaine, both the environment and the atmosphere.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the children...

dialogues.speaker: Alphonso
dialogues.text: Kavus, Sudabeh, and Iotham are very good kids. They are so full of energy.

dialogues.speaker: Alphonso
dialogues.text: But some parts of the forest are too dangerous. Every time they go missing, I always wished if only they weren't that curious.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Rana...

dialogues.speaker: Alphonso
dialogues.text: Rana is responsible and loved by those "tiger cubs"...

dialogues.speaker: Alphonso
dialogues.text: But she's always busy in the forest. I really wish she would rest a little more.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Alphonso
dialogues.text: Alright. I hope you like it here.

dialogues.speaker: Alphonso
dialogues.text: *sigh* What should I do if this goes on, Rana...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Rana will be fine.

dialogues.speaker: Alphonso
dialogues.text: I'll take your word for it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Iotham...

dialogues.speaker: Alphonso
dialogues.text: The good news is Iotham is unharmed. But... the incident with Rana was a major blow to him.

dialogues.speaker: Alphonso
dialogues.text: But as they say, "Do not yield to the wind, or the rain. Do not yield to the winter snow, or the summer heat..."

dialogues.speaker: Alphonso
dialogues.text: It's these setbacks that help us grow stronger. I hope Iotham will learn from this experience too.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Alphonso
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Alphonso
dialogues.text: What should I do about my mission?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Let's leave quietly.)

dialogues.speaker: Alphonso
dialogues.text: What should I do...
